Flush procedure: Press ENTER on the Keypad.

steps.title: Prepare and Weigh Filter Bags
steps.instruction: Label and weigh filter bags to prepare them for sample loading.

substeps.instruction: Label filter bags using a solvent resistant marker.
Weigh each empty filter bag to the nearest 0.0001 g and record the weight in Fulcrum (do not pre-dry bags).

steps.title: Load and Seal Samples
steps.instruction: Add sample material to the bags and seal them securely.

substeps.instruction: Place 0.45–0.50 g of prepared sample into up to 23 bags, recording each weight to the nearest 0.0001 g in Fulcrum; avoid placing sample in the upper 4 mm of the bag.
Include at least one empty bag in the run for blank bag correction (C1).
Seal each bag closed within 4 mm of the top using a heat sealer, allowing 2 s of cool time before removal.
Gently shake the bags to spread the sample uniformly and eliminate clumping.

steps.title: Set Up ANKOM2000 for NDF Extraction
steps.instruction: Prepare the instrument and load the sample bags for Neutral Detergent Fiber (NDF) analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place up to 3 bags on each of eight Bag Suspender Trays (max 24 bags), stacking them on the center post and rotating each level 120 degrees, with an empty 9th tray on top.
Verify hot water supply is on (room B-236) and temperature is >70 °C.
Attach the Neutral Detergent (ND) solution hose to the Cubetainer and then to Port A.
Ensure the drain hose is securely positioned in an empty yellow waste bin.
Insert the Bag Suspender into the Vessel and place the Bag Suspender weight on the 9th tray to keep it submerged.

steps.title: Run NDF Extraction
steps.instruction: Execute the NDF extraction process using the instrument display.

substeps.instruction: Select 'NDF' on the ANKOM2000 display.
Close the Vessel Lid and press START (process takes approximately 01:30:00).

steps.title: Dry and Weigh NDF Samples
steps.instruction: Recover, dry, and weigh the bags after NDF extraction.

substeps.instruction: Remove filter bags from the Vessel and gently press out excess water.
Dry bags in an oven at 102 ± 2°C for 3 h.
Immediately transfer dry bags to a collapsible desiccant pouch, flatten to remove air, and cool to ambient temperature for 00:30:00.
Weigh bags to the nearest 0.0001 g and record in Fulcrum.

steps.title: Prepare for ADF Extraction
steps.instruction: Clean the instrument and prepare the bags for Acid Detergent Fiber (ADF) analysis.

substeps.instruction: Remove and label the yellow waste bin after it has cooled.
Re-arrange bags on the Bag Suspender Trays (max 24 bags, 8 trays rotated 120 degrees, empty 9th tray on top).
Insert the drain hose into an empty white waste bin.
Check the Temperature Controller; if >20 °C, fill the Vessel with cold water and run the Flush Procedure until it reaches 20 °C.
Detach cubitainers from ports A and B and run a flush procedure to clean the system with water.
Attach the acid detergent (AD) solution hose to the Cubetainer and then to Port B.
Insert the Bag Suspender into the Vessel and place the Bag Suspender weight on the 9th tray.
Select 'ADF' on the display, close the Vessel Lid, confirm hot water is >70 °C, and press START (process takes 01:00:00).

steps.title: Dry and Weigh ADF Samples
steps.instruction: Recover, dry, and weigh the bags after ADF extraction.

substeps.instruction: Remove filter bags from the Vessel and gently press out excess water.
Dry bags in an oven at 102 ± 2°C for 3 h.
Run a flush procedure if necessary by detaching cubitainers from ports A and B.
Immediately transfer dry bags to a collapsible desiccant pouch, flatten to remove air, and cool to ambient temperature.
Weigh bags to the nearest 0.0001 g and record in Fulcrum.

steps.title: Prepare 72% H2SO4 Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the concentrated acid solution under a chemical hood with appropriate PPE.

substeps.instruction: Measure 242 ml of dH2O into a 2 L glass beaker on a stirring plate with a magnetic stir bar.
Slowly add 758 mL of H2SO4 to the water while stirring at slow speed.
Allow the solution to cool for at least 1 h.
Adjust the final volume to 1 L using a 1 L glass cylinder with dH2O and aliquot into 250 ml bottles.

steps.title: Acid Digestion of Samples
steps.instruction: Digest the samples with acid to determine lignin content.

substeps.instruction: Place completely dry, ambient-temperature filter bags into a 2 L glass beaker and cover with approximately 250 ml of 72% H2SO4.
Place a 1 L beaker inside the 2 L beaker to keep bags submerged.
After 3 h, pour off the H2SO4 into a white waste bin with a pink label.
Rinse bags with tap water until pH paper shows a neutral color, handling bags gently to avoid losing fine lignin particles.

steps.title: Dry and Weigh Lignin Samples
steps.instruction: Dry and weigh the bags after acid digestion.

substeps.instruction: Dry bags in an oven at 100 °C for 3 h.
Place bags in a Desiccant/Moisture Stop pouch, flatten to remove air, cool to ambient temperature, and weigh to the nearest 0.0001 g.

steps.title: Prepare Crucibles for Combustion
steps.instruction: Clean and weigh crucibles for the final analysis step.

substeps.instruction: Rinse 24 crucibles and covers with dH2O.
Dry crucibles and covers in an oven at 150 °C for 1 h.
Cool crucibles (with lids on) in a metal desiccator for 01:30:00.
Weigh empty crucibles with lids to the nearest 0.0001 g (do not wear gloves to avoid static) and record in Fulcrum.

steps.title: Final Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Transfer samples to crucibles and perform final weighing.

substeps.instruction: Fold filter bags into four and insert each into its corresponding numbered crucible; cover with lid.
Transfer crucibles (with lids on) to a metal desiccator for 01:30:00 after turning off the muffle furnace.
Weigh crucibles with lids to the nearest 0.0001 g and record in Fulcrum.
Wash crucibles and lids with tap water.

steps.title: Instrument Flush and Maintenance
steps.instruction: Perform a comprehensive system flush and prepare amylase dispenser.

substeps.instruction: Verify drain hose is in a waste bin and select 'Flush' on the display.
Attach Amylase Dispenser Assembly to Port B, fill with 100 ml hot water, then attach to Port A and fill with 100 ml hot water.
To rinse the Vessel bottom, hold the START key during Flush; pour hot water manually into the Vessel to rinse the top.
Prepare amylase solution: add 50 ml tap water to the dispenser, add 8.0 mL of alpha-amylase, and fill to the line with tap water.
Attach the Amylase Dispenser Assembly to Port B and weigh 20 g of Sodium sulfite for later use.
